          </p:nvPr>
        </p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">

import io

CT = "unpacked/[Content_Types].xml"
RELS = "unpacked/ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"
PRES = "unpacked/ppt/presentation.xml"

ct_anchor = '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
ct_add = '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'

rels_anchor = '<Relationship Id="rId12" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide5.xml"/>'
rels_add = '<Relationship Id="rId13" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide6.xml"/>'

pres_anchor = '    <p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>'
pres_add = '    <p:sldId id="261" r:id="rId13"/>'

for path, anchor, add in ((CT, ct_anchor, ct_add), (RELS, rels_anchor, rels_add), (PRES, pres_anchor, pres_add)):
    with io.open(path, "r", encoding="ascii") as f:
        data = f.read()
    count = data.count(anchor)
    assert count == 1, "%s: anchor found %d times" % (path, count)
    assert add not in data, "%s: already added" % path
    data = data.replace(anchor, anchor + "\n" + add)
    with io.open(path, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
        f.write(data)
    print("updated", path)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {
    "p": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main",
    "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
}

z = zipfile.ZipFile("Q4_financial_report.pptx")
bad = z.testzip()
assert bad is None, "corrupt zip member: %s" % bad

names = z.namelist()
required = [
    "ppt/slides/slide1.xml", "ppt/slides/slide2.xml", "ppt/slides/slide3.xml",
    "ppt/slides/slide4.xml", "ppt/slides/slide5.xml", "ppt/slides/slide6.xml",
    "ppt/slides/_rels/slide6.xml.rels", "[Content_Types].xml",
    "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels", "ppt/presentation.xml",
]
missing = [n for n in required if n not in names]
assert not missing, "missing: %s" % missing

pres = ET.fromstring(z.read("ppt/presentation.xml"))
ids = [(s.get("id"), s.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"))
       for s in pres.find("p:sldIdLst", NS)]
assert ids[-1] == ("261", "rId13"), ids

s6 = ET.fromstring(z.read("ppt/slides/slide6.xml"))
texts = [el.text for el in s6.iter() if el.tag.endswith("}t") and el.text]
assert texts == ["Thank you for your attention"], texts

print("slides in order:", ids)
print("slide6 text:", texts)
print("OK: packed Q4_financial_report.pptx valid, 6 slides")
